description: Enable ralph-dashboard to monitor Ralph instances across multiple projects from a central registry at ~/.ralph/global/ (Linux/macOS) or $env:USERPROFILE\.ralph\global\ (Windows). Full cross-platform support for both Bash and PowerShell implementations.

userStories.title: Global Registry Directory Structure
acceptanceCriteria: ~/.ralph/global/instances/ directory is created on first Ralph run (Bash)
$env:USERPROFILE\.ralph\global\instances\ directory is created on first Ralph run (PowerShell)
~/.ralph/global/locks/ directory is created for future global lock support
Directory structure is created with appropriate permissions (700 on Unix)
Existing local functionality continues to work unchanged
Both ralph.sh and ralph.ps1 create the same directory structure
Tests pass: directory creation works on both platforms
userStories.notes: Foundation story - creates the global registry directories. Add RALPH_GLOBAL_DIR env var override support.

userStories.title: Global Instance Registration (Bash)
acceptanceCriteria: ralph.sh creates a symlink in ~/.ralph/global/instances/ pointing to the local instance directory
Symlink name follows format: {project-name}-{instance-id} for uniqueness
Symlink is created atomically using ln -sfn
Registration happens in init_instance() function
Local instance directory still exists and functions normally
RALPH_GLOBAL_DISABLE=1 skips global registration
Tests pass: symlink created and resolves correctly
userStories.notes: Bash implementation of global registration. Uses basename of PROJECT_ROOT for project-name.

userStories.title: Global Instance Registration (PowerShell)
acceptanceCriteria: ralph.ps1 creates a junction in $env:USERPROFILE\.ralph\global\instances\
Uses New-Item -ItemType Junction for directory links (works without admin on Windows)
Junction name follows same format: {project-name}-{instance-id}
Registration happens in Initialize-Instance or equivalent function
Fallback to copying status.json if junction creation fails
$env:RALPH_GLOBAL_DISABLE=1 skips global registration
Tests pass: junction created and resolves correctly
userStories.notes: PowerShell implementation of global registration. Junction points work on NTFS without admin.

userStories.title: Global Instance Deregistration
acceptanceCriteria: ralph.sh removes the global symlink in cleanup_on_exit()
ralph.ps1 removes the global junction in cleanup handler
Removal is idempotent (no error if already removed)
Local instance cleanup still functions normally
Deregistration logs the action
Tests pass: cleanup removes global entries
userStories.notes: Both Bash and PowerShell implementations for cleanup on exit.

userStories.title: Dashboard Global View Mode (Bash)
acceptanceCriteria: --all flag sets INSTANCES_DIR to ~/.ralph/global/instances/
Dashboard resolves symlinks to read actual status.json files
Instance display includes project name extracted from symlink name
Header shows GLOBAL VIEW indicator when in global mode
PRD progress bar is hidden in global mode (no single PRD)
Tests pass: dashboard shows instances from multiple projects
userStories.notes: Update ralph-dashboard.sh to support --all flag for global view.

userStories.title: Dashboard Global View Mode (PowerShell)
acceptanceCriteria: -All switch sets instances path to global directory
Dashboard resolves junctions to read actual status.json files
Instance display includes project name extracted from junction name
Header shows GLOBAL VIEW indicator when in global mode
PRD progress bar is hidden in global mode
Uses Get-Item to resolve junction targets
Tests pass: dashboard shows instances from multiple projects
userStories.notes: Update ralph-dashboard.ps1 to support -All switch for global view.

userStories.title: Dashboard Repository Filter
acceptanceCriteria: --repo PATH (Bash) and -Repo PATH (PowerShell) filter instances by projectRoot
Filter works with both absolute and relative paths
Filter works in both local and global modes
Partial path matching is supported (e.g., --repo mojo-ode matches /home/user/mojo-ode)
Message shown if no instances match the filter
Tests pass: filter correctly limits displayed instances
userStories.notes: Implement --repo/-Repo filter in both dashboard implementations.

userStories.title: Stale Symlink/Junction Cleanup
acceptanceCriteria: Broken symlinks (Bash) and broken junctions (PowerShell) are detected
Cleanup runs on dashboard startup when --all/-All is used
Cleanup runs periodically in ralph.sh/ralph.ps1 cleanup functions
ralph-cleanup.sh --global and ralph-cleanup.ps1 -Global for manual cleanup
Cleanup logs removed entries
Tests pass: broken links are removed automatically
userStories.notes: Add --global/-Global flag to cleanup scripts for global registry maintenance.

userStories.title: Global Registry in Status Output
acceptanceCriteria: ralph-status.sh shows Global: registered or Global: not registered
ralph-status.ps1 shows equivalent status information
Shows path to global symlink/junction when registered
--global/-Global flag shows all globally registered instances
Tests pass: status correctly reports global registration
userStories.notes: Update status scripts to show global registration state.

userStories.title: RalphUtils.psm1 Global Functions
acceptanceCriteria: Get-RalphGlobalDir function returns the global registry path
Register-RalphGlobalInstance creates global junction for an instance
Unregister-RalphGlobalInstance removes global junction
Get-RalphGlobalInstances lists all globally registered instances
Clear-RalphStaleGlobalEntries removes broken junctions
All functions are exported from RalphUtils.psm1
Tests pass: all global functions work correctly
userStories.notes: Add reusable PowerShell functions for global registry operations to RalphUtils.psm1.

compatibility.statusFormat: Existing JSON with instanceId, projectRoot fields used for identification
